Eventually, we aim at improving our renewable energy modelling and forecasting skills, since it may be possible to generate forecasts of close to state-of-the-art quality without too much effort. We cover a number of *advanced topics in renewable energy forecasting*, taking you further than the basic concepts and approaches of the previous module.

This module covers:

- Going beyond linear regression
- Accepting nonstationarity and letting models evolve with time
- A systematic approach to modelling decisions based on available data
